ai_language_tip: Use English (en) across English-speaking provinces; use French (fr) first in Quebec (Montreal often greets 'Bonjour-Hi' and switches smoothly).
english_ok: often — Nationwide outside non-metropolitan Quebec, where French is required or strongly expected.
politeness: Polite, friendly, apologetic-warm ('Hi there, calling on behalf of...', 'please', 'thanks so much'); in French always use 'Bonjour' and 'vous'.
name_tip: First and last name (e.g. Alex Taylor, Jean Tremblay); spell surnames clearly; restaurants hold under first + last name.
phone_tip: 10-digit NANPA format 416-555-0123 or 514-555-0199 read 3-3-4 (area code always required); confirmations via SMS or email.
time_tip: 12-hour AM/PM in English ('7:30 PM'), 24-hour common in Quebec French ('19 h 30'); confirm time zone only for national lines.
number_tip: In English '0' is 'oh' or 'zero'; in Quebec French 70/80/90 are standard soixante-dix, quatre-vingts, quatre-vingt-dix; watch 15 vs 50.
avoid_calling: Avoid restaurant rush 12:00–13:30 and 18:00–20:00, clinic lunch 12:00–13:00, and calls after 20:30.
closed_days: Many salons and independent bistros close Mondays (and Sundays/Mondays in Quebec); statutory holidays vary by province.
booking_channels: OpenTable, Resy, and Tock for dining; Jane App widely used by physio/RMT/chiro/clinics; Bonjour-santé/RVSQ in Quebec and Medimap for walk-in clinics.
voice_menu: Medical clinics, dental groups, pharmacies, banks, telcos (Rogers/Bell/Telus), CRA/Service Canada, and dealerships use heavy keypad IVR.
callback_habits: OpenTable/Resy and Jane App send automated SMS/email confirmations and 24h reminders; trades and garages call back from voicemails.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 都會區熱門餐廳多用 OpenTable 或 Resy 留卡擔保，一般餐廳與酒吧普遍接受電話訂位。
usually_asked: Date and preferred reservation time
Party size including kids or highchair/stroller
Main dining room vs patio (seasonal) or bar/lounge
Full name and 10-digit phone number
Allergies or special occasion note

may_come_up.what: Patio seating is walk-in only and weather-dependent
Large party (6–8+) requires set menu or auto-gratuity (18–20%)
Sends Resy/OpenTable SMS link to add card hold

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone for group hold

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 家庭醫師診所多有按鍵分機且僅收名冊病患，必問各省健保卡號與生日；牙醫、物理治療與按摩（RMT）較好電話預約。
usually_asked: Existing rostered patient vs new/walk-in patient
Appointment type (family doctor, dental cleaning, RMT, physio)
Patient full legal name
Preferred date, time, and practitioner
10-digit phone number and email (often for Jane App intake)

may_come_up.what: Clinic phone starts with keypad IVR ('press 1 for reception')
Quebec clinics direct to RVSQ or Bonjour-santé portal
Asks whether direct-billing extended health insurance

sensitive_asked.what: Asks provincial health card number (OHIP/RAMQ/MSP) or date of birth
Asks private insurance policy/certificate number or credit card on file

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 部分美甲美睫或高階髮廊會要求留信用卡在系統作 24 小時取消擔保。
usually_asked: Service details (cut, balayage, gel manicure, non-RMT spa massage)
Hair length/thickness or gel removal need
Preferred date, time, and stylist/technician
New or returning client
Name and 10-digit phone number

may_come_up.what: Clarifies whether client needs RMT receipt for insurance claim
24-hour cancellation fee policy applies

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card over phone to hold long colour appointment
Demands immediate Interac e-Transfer deposit

repair.before_dialing_zh: 原廠車廠（Dealership）多有按鍵分機，10～11月與3～4月換雪胎旺季常需提前數週預約。
usually_asked: Vehicle year, make, model (or device model)
Service needed (oil change, winter tire swap on/off rims, brake check)
Drop-off vs waiting in lounge ('waiter appointment')
Preferred date and morning/afternoon slot
Name and 10-digit number

may_come_up.what: For tire swap, asks whether winter tires are already on rims
Quotes diagnostic fee plus tax before repair

sensitive_asked.what: Requests phone unlock passcode
Demands card deposit over phone for special part

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 獨立披薩店、中餐、壽司與印度菜普遍接受電話點自取（Pickup）到店付款。
usually_asked: Pickup vs in-house delivery and branch location check
Items, sizes, combos, and allergy notes
Ready time (usually 15–30 minutes)
Name and 10-digit phone number

may_come_up.what: Prices quoted exclude provincial/federal tax (GST/HST/QST)
Delivery handled only via Uber Eats / DoorDash / SkipTheDishes

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card over phone to prepay large order

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型量販店（Canadian Tire、Home Depot等）必經按鍵選部門，獨立專賣店可直接問庫存並留貨到打烊。
usually_asked: Exact product name, brand, size, or SKU
Quantity and visual shelf check ('physical stock check')
Same-day pickup window at customer service desk
Customer name and 10-digit number

may_come_up.what: Big-box store uses keypad IVR to reach specific department
Holds unpaid item at front desk until closing time only

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card or Interac e-Transfer to reserve item

change.before_dialing_zh: 牙醫、物理治療與餐廳常有 24 小時內改退收取爽約費用的規定。
usually_asked: Full name and 10-digit phone number
Original appointment/reservation date and time
Reschedule request or cancellation
New preferred date and time

may_come_up.what: Late cancellation fee ($50+ at dental/RMT clinics) within 24–48h

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks date of birth to verify patient chart

usually_asked: Specific question (holiday hours, walk-in wait, patio open, parking, dog policy)
Intended arrival time and group size
Whether caller wants to join waitlist or book
Callback number if staff needs to check manager

may_come_up.what: Statutory holiday hours differ from Google Maps listing
Corkage ('BYOW / Apportez votre vin' in QC) rules explained

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店與度假木屋電話訂房幾乎必問信用卡號擔保，且大型飯店總機常有按鍵選單。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates
Adults, children, and pets
Room type (king vs two queens)
Guest full name, phone, and email

may_come_up.what: Parking fee, resort fee, plus provincial/municipal room taxes extra
Offers sending online booking link so owner enters card directly

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number and expiry to guarantee reservation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 高爾夫、保齡球、密室與冰壺/球場散客多走網站預付，團體或社區場館可電話問空檔。
usually_asked: Activity, lane, simulator bay, or court type
Date, start time, and duration
Group headcount
Name, 10-digit phone, and email

may_come_up.what: Directs standard bookings to website checkout
Shoe/equipment rental extra per person

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card over phone to hold bay/lane

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須提供完整地址（含公寓房號與郵遞區號），大樓公寓維修常需預約貨梯或管理處放行。
usually_asked: Issue details (furnace/HVAC, plumbing, duct cleaning, snow/lawn, locksmith)
Full street address, unit/buzzer info, and postal code
House vs condo (condo water shut-off or elevator rules)
Preferred service window
Homeowner/tenant name and 10-digit phone

may_come_up.what: Quotes dispatch/diagnostic call-out fee plus tax
Tenant must obtain landlord approval before billable work

sensitive_asked.what: Asks keypad lock PIN, garage code, or alarm code
Demands Interac e-Transfer deposit upfront

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、美容與寄宿皆需預約，寄宿與日托必查狂犬病與 Bordetella（犬舍咳）疫苗紀錄。
usually_asked: New vs existing client and service needed (vet exam, groom, boarding)
Species, breed, weight, age, and spay/neuter status
Rabies, DHPP, and Bordetella vaccine status
Preferred date and time
Owner full name and 10-digit phone

may_come_up.what: Daycare/boarding requires paid half-day temperament evaluation first
Vet clinic currently not accepting new patients

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card deposit over phone for new grooming client

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Canada Post、Purolator、FedEx 全國專線皆為語音機器人或按鍵選單，地方獨立商店與車廠才適合直撥。
usually_asked: Tracking, work-order, or invoice number
Customer name and 10-digit phone
Delivery postal code or item description
Pickup readiness or status check

may_come_up.what: National courier hotline requires keypad/automated bot

sensitive_asked.what: Asks account PIN or payment card digits

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、電信、水電、CRA 稅務局與加拿大航空皆有多層按鍵 IVR 並強制核對本人個資，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: IVR language and department keypad selection
Verification that caller is primary account holder
Date of birth, postal code, and account PIN/security question
Account or booking reference

may_come_up.what: Blocked at keypad IVR or PIPEDA privacy check

sensitive_asked.what: Asks SIN, date of birth, phone banking PIN, card number, or OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 地方計程車行（如 Beck Taxi、Bonjour Taxi）、機場禮賓車與租車門市皆可電話叫車或預約。
usually_asked: Exact pickup address (with unit/door info) and pickup time
Destination or airport terminal
Passenger count, luggage, or wheelchair/van request
Passenger name and 10-digit phone number

may_come_up.what: Airport flat-rate zone tariff vs meter explained
Car rental requires credit card in driver's own name at counter

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card or driver's license number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: 大樓物業（Purpose-built rental）與房仲電話約看房時，常先確認起租日（多為每月1號）、預算與養寵需求。
usually_asked: Building address, bedroom size, or MLS/listing reference
Target move-in date (typically 1st of month; July 1 peak in Quebec)
Number of occupants, pets, and parking stall need
Preferred viewing date and time
Prospective tenant name and 10-digit phone

may_come_up.what: 24-hour statutory notice to current tenant required before showing
Agent asks employment status and rough credit-score readiness

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Social Insurance Number (SIN) over phone
Requests rent deposit before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 聯邦/省府與市府（311）多有語音選單，個人案件不對外透露；私立托兒所（Daycare）可電話問名額與約參觀。
usually_asked: Program, municipal service, or daycare age group inquired
Child age in months (infant/toddler/preschool) for daycare waitlist
Municipality or school board catchment
Caller name and 10-digit callback number

may_come_up.what: Subsidized daycare requires centralized municipal/provincial waitlist (e.g. La Place 0-5 in QC)
Switchboard requires keypad extension

sensitive_asked.what: Asks SIN, health card, or child date of birth
